title: Warren Buffett's Real Secret Isn't Stock Picking 🤯 #shorts
description:
Of Warren Buffett's $84.5 billion, $81.5 billion came after his 65th birthday. The real secret is time and compounding.
Source: Morgan Housel, "The Psychology of Money" (2020).
script: Warren Buffett's real secret isn't picking stocks. It's time.
He bought his first stock at just eleven years old.
By thirty, he was a millionaire. Impressive, but not legendary.
Of his eighty-four point five billion dollar fortune, eighty-one point five billion came after his sixty-fifth birthday.
That's compounding. Money making money, on money it already made.
If he had started at thirty and retired at sixty, he'd be worth about twelve million. You would never know his name.
So the best time to start was yesterday. The second best time is today.
